features.name: Lay On Hands
features.description: Pool of healing equal to 5 x Paladin level. Bonus Action: touch a creature and restore HP from the pool, or spend 5 points to remove the Poisoned condition.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons (Longsword: Sap, Javelin: Slow). Can swap after a Long Rest.

features.name: Fighting Style: Defense
features.description: +1 AC while wearing armor (already in combat.acBonus).

features.name: Paladin's Smite
features.description: Divine Smite is always prepared, and once per Long Rest it can be cast without a spell slot (tracked on the spell).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Two uses. Regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest. Options: Divine Sense, Sacred Weapon.

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.description: When you take the Attack action, spend a Channel Divinity use: for 10 minutes add your Cha modifier (min +1) to attack rolls with one melee weapon; it can deal Radiant damage and sheds light.

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.description: For 1 minute: Sorcerer spell save DC +1 and Advantage on Sorcerer spell attack rolls.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: Sorcery Points fuel Metamagic. You can turn spell slots into points and points into slots (Bonus Action).

features.name: Metamagic: Quickened Spell
features.description: 2 Sorcery Points: a spell with a casting time of an action becomes a Bonus Action. Not if you already cast a level 1+ spell this turn.

features.name: Metamagic: Twinned Spell
features.description: 1 Sorcery Point: raise the effective level of a spell that targets an extra creature per level by 1.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: HP maximum +3, and +1 per further Sorcerer level. Without armor, base AC = 10 + Dex + Cha (set as unarmoredAc).

features.name: Pact of the Blade
features.description: Conjure a pact weapon or bond with a magic weapon. You are proficient with it and can use Cha for its attack and damage rolls; it can deal Necrotic, Psychic or Radiant damage.

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.description: Replace one attack of the Attack action: 15-ft Cone or 30-ft Line. Dex save DC 8 + Con mod + PB, 2d10 Fire (half on success).

features.name: Draconic Flight
features.description: Spectral wings for 10 minutes: Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: See in dim light within 60 feet as if bright, and in darkness as if dim.

features.name: Magic Initiate (Cleric)
features.description: Guidance and Sacred Flame cantrips; Bless always prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot (tracked on the spell). Charisma is the spellcasting ability for these.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: Ranged spell attack, 2d10 Fire at character level 5+.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: An object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.description: Minor magical tricks.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.description: Melee spell attack, Lightning damage; target can't make Opportunity Attacks.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: Beams of force; 2 beams at character level 5+, 1d10 Force each.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.description: A sound or an image of an object.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: A willing creature adds 1d4 to ability checks with one chosen skill.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.description: Dex save or Radiant damage.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.castingTime: Bonus Action, after hitting with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike
spells.description: The target takes extra 2d8 Radiant damage (+1d8 per slot level above 1; +1d8 vs Fiends and Undead).

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.description: +2 AC to one creature.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.description: Protection against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: Heal 2d8 + spellcasting modifier.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.description: Immune to Frightened; Temporary HP each turn.

spells.name: Command
spells.description: One-word command (Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt).

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.description: Ranged spell attack, 3d8 of a chosen damage type; may leap to another target.

spells.name: Shield
spells.castingTime: Reaction, when hit by an attack or targeted by Magic Missile
spells.description: +5 AC until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: Three darts, 1d4 + 1 Force each, never miss.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: Sense magic within 30 feet.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.description: Aquatic adaptation, change appearance, or natural weapons.

spells.name: Dragon's Breath
spells.description: A creature can exhale a 15-foot Cone of damage as a Magic action.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Teleport up to 30 feet.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.description: Wis save or a Humanoid is Paralyzed.

spells.name: Hex
spells.description: +1d6 Necrotic on hits against the target; Disadvantage on checks with one ability.

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.castingTime: Reaction, when damaged by a creature within 60 feet
spells.description: Dex save, 2d10 Fire (half on success).

items.name: Chain Mail
items.description: Heavy armor. Strength 13 required; Disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
items.description: Spend 1-3 charges to cast Magic Missile (level 1 + 1 per extra charge). If the last charge is spent, roll d20: on a 1 the wand crumbles.

roleplay.appearance: Tall, gold-scaled, with a chipped left horn and a temple tabard worn over chain mail.
roleplay.personality: Warm and loud, laughs easily, takes promises too seriously.
roleplay.ideals: Protection. The strong owe a debt to everyone weaker than them.
roleplay.bonds: The burned temple of Saint Ilvara, and the orphans it used to feed.
roleplay.flaws: Cannot walk away from a fight that looks unfair, even when walking away is wiser.
roleplay.voice: Deep and slow; rolls the r's; calls everyone 'little flame'.
roleplay.mannerisms: Taps her horn when thinking. Hums hymns off-key before battle.
roleplay.goals: Find out who whispers to her at night (the warlock patron) and whether it is the saint.
roleplay.backstory: Raised in a temple as an acolyte, she woke her draconic blood during the fire that destroyed it. Since then a voice offers help, and she has said yes once.
roleplay.allies: Brother Tomas (temple survivor), the Ember Guard in Varrow.

sessionNotes.title: Session 12
sessionNotes.text: Cleared the flooded crypt. Got the Wand of Magic Missiles. The voice gave a name: 'Vessa'.
